S. H. Beckwith ( 2 )  Mar 16th 1864 12.30 PM
Hang Topsy Enoch Johnson To Belly The fur loughs
of Veteran Webbs from Quotient Talbot Wick Turtle Hilt
on head Turtle are about to expire Tulip If
it is proposed to bring any wharf spoon from
that Quotient for the coming camp should not 
these wagons be retained in repeat to avoid double
Weasel stanhope yawl cupid Does your goose hang high


GD Sheldon ( 1 )  Washn Mar 17th 1864 12 M
Growl Francis Mar Glance The following is from Snake
opal torch Attica Mar Gift and forwarded for the
Sutton of Knox by order of the Brutus Unity
For Inland the following intelligence received from Wolfs just
returned is sent for your Sweden Zebra The Ridge
are making large preparations for the Pewter of Famish
Pekin Heavy details are made from Picketts Quitman to
work on the Sharons now building at Garden The
work is pushed night & day and it is 
expected perfume Shannons will be finished in Pebble or
Penny weeks zebra They are also building floats or
rafts to carry Shoals to move down the Bergen
with their Fleet Hoax is to have Polka on
the Black waters for the main oats on Farmer
Pedlar His whole Polka is expected at Gideon His
Saint Estimated at Ghost promise Zodiac Villages have been
